## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a clear purpose and a focused diff.
- [ ] Tests cover expected behavior and relevant edge cases (rule changes need positive, negative and edge fixtures).
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when CLI, report or rule behavior changes.
- [ ] Findings do not overstate certainty; limitations are recorded.
- [ ] No secrets or private source code are included.
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass locally (and the website checks if `website/` changed).
